Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

year noun

also years, this year, last year, all year, for a year, twice a year, the following year, the previous year, happy New Year, a hundred years from now

classical

Cic. Sen. 24: tam senex quī sē annum nōn putet posse vīvere
Traupman 89, 409

annus, annī m.

noun, second declension

Ages: quārtum agō annum et octōgēsimum, I am in my eighty-fourth year (Cic. Sen. 32); see how old are you.

Other words

  • hōc annō — this year

    also used · classical · Cic. Red. Sen. 9 (M-O s.v. last year)

  • annō superiōre — last year

    also used · classical · Cic. Har. Resp. 15 (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. last year; Traupman 409

  • annō proximō — next year; in a story, the following year

    also used · classical · Traupman 89: the following year, proximus annus; Traupman 409

    proximus looks either way; see last (the one before this).

Examples

  • nēmō enim est tam senex quī sē annum nōn putet posse vīvere

    for no one is so old that he doesn’t think he can live another yearCic. Sen. 24

  • tōtum annum mustum erit

    you will have grape juice all yearCato Agr. 120

  • quārtum agō annum et octōgēsimum

    I am in my eighty-fourth yearCic. Sen. 32

  • ad centum annōs

    a hundred years from nowTraupman 409

  • in annum

    for a yearTraupman 409

  • Novum Annum laetum tibi exoptō.

    I wish you a happy New Year.Traupman 409

  • proximus annus

    the following yearTraupman 409

  • superior annus

    the previous yearTraupman 409

  • bis (in) annō

    twice a yearTraupman 409

See also every year, at the beginning of the year, New Year’s Day, how old are you?, month, week, ago, last, next year.
